subject: SIG: Third-party footprint reconciliation for telemetry & infra
messages:
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Zhang <elaine.zhang@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: updated third-party inventory for SIG completion

Hi Stephanie,

As part of Acme Health's SIG submission for our procurement review, we need Redwood to provide an up-to-date list of subprocessors that handle customer data. Specifically, could you provide:

- A CSV export of current subprocessors (name, vendor role, data types processed, region/egress, contract owner)
- Indicate which vendors are used for cloud infra, telemetry/observability, incident response, support/ticketing, and crash reporting
- Copies or links to SOC2 or equivalent attestations for the above categories if available
- Any known subprocessor contracts where subcontracting is permitted (e.g., cloud provider partners)

We'd like to have this by EOD next Tuesday (2026-11-10) to keep the timeline for our legal review. If there are any blockers (NDAs/contract redlines) let us know early.

Thanks,
Lindsey Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Health

Hi team — attached is the latest export I pulled last week and annotated per the template we agreed on. High-level summary below.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_export_20261129.csv (CSV stub)

Key vendors called out:
- Cloud provider: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — projects: redwood-prod-1, redwood-telemetry-2 (egress: US, EU)
- Observability/Telemetry: FluxSight (ingestion + sampled traces), Datadog (metrics + alerting), Sentry (error/crash reporting)
- Support/ticketing: Zendesk (customer-facing support), Intercom (in-app support for trials)
- Backup/archive: Backblaze for cold storage (encrypted at rest)
- Identity: Okta (SaaS IDP)

Notes on data flows:
- Telemetry: FluxSight receives sampled traces; PII is redacted at source for traces. Datadog receives aggregated metrics only. Sentry receives stack traces and anonymized identifiers (no full user profiles).
- Contract flags: GCP subcontracting allowed (multi-region CDNs) — see comment column in CSV.

Please review the CSV and let me know if we should surface any additional documents (SOCs, contracts).

— Mina
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Thanks for the export, Mina — that helps. A couple quick follow-ups from Acme Health's risk team:

- Could you flag which vendors are considered 'critical' by Redwood (i.e., would materially impact service if unavailable)?
- For FluxSight and Sentry: can you confirm whether logs/traces sent to those services ever contain PHI under any ingestion scenarios?
- Please include a brief timeline of any security incidents or P1 vendor outages in the last 12 months for these vendors (even if vendor-managed).

If possible we'd prefer a single consolidated spreadsheet that has the vendor rows plus the new columns above. Can you send that by COB tomorrow 2026-12-01?

Regards,
Lindsey Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Health

Hi Lindsey — attaching the consolidated file and quick responses inline.

Attachments: sig_evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx, redwood_subprocessor_export_20261129.csv

Summary (answers):
- Critical vendors: GCP (core compute/storage), FluxSight (critical for observability of inference clusters), Datadog (critical for alerting), Zendesk (critical for support triage). These are flagged in the spreadsheet column "criticality".
- PHI/PIM exposure: We do not send full PHI to telemetry vendors. FluxSight receives sampled traces with PII redacted; Sentry receives anonymized identifiers and stack frames only. I've included the security rationale in the "security_notes" tab.
- Incidents: In the last 12 months, there were two vendor incidents noted in monitoring: a transient Datadog metrics ingestion lag (2026-02-14) and a regional GCP network outage affecting one latency tier (2026-06-03). Both had no customer data loss; summaries are in the incident_notes tab.

Links: consolidated evidence and SOC docs are in the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSIG-Evidence-Pathway

Next steps:
- Please confirm if you need vendor contracts or redacted SOC reports; Marissa is available to run any necessary redactions.
- If Acme wants an on-call walkthrough of the data flows, we can schedule a 30-minute technical session with our infra and security engineers.

Thanks — will stand by for any additional asks.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, GTM Security Operations | Redwood Inference
